equalang-equalang-skill-root.description: Translate whole files with Equalang, keeping their layout - documents (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, EPUB, HTML, TXT), subtitles (SRT, VTT), pictures, and audio or video (which come back as translated subtitles) - and transcribe recordings into timed text. Use when the user points at a FILE or a URL of one and wants it translated or transcribed, or wants strings translated in bulk; not for a sentence you can translate yourself.
